Today Yagav Buchstab should have celebrated his 37th birthday, but he will forever remain 35. Yagav was born on January 23, 1989. Eldest son to Oren and Esther, older brother to Nofer and Yuval. A member of Kibbutz Nirim, whose heart was captured by the world of music. When he started learning to play guitar and cello, he revealed himself to be a gifted musician and in his high school years he was even part of a band. Yagav taught himself to play the organ, bagpipes, clarinet and more, each instrument opened up a new and magical world for him. Yagav loved building electric guitars and other instruments together with his brother Yuval. In his adulthood, his love for music led him to study sound, and manage a recording studio. As usual, he didn't give up until every recording was perfect.  Music also brought his lover Rimon into his life. Yagav and Ramon met in their youth in a group where they played together, Yagav as a guitarist and Ramon on drums. About two years before they were kidnapped from their home in Nirim, they got married in the yard of their parents' house. They built their home in Kibbutz Nirim, a home where they raised five dogs and five cats, most of them adopted after being abused.  Along with the sounds, there were also smells of cooking coming from the kitchen of their home. Yagav loved to cook from a young age and the kitchen was for him a place of original creation, experimenting with different techniques and testing new ideas. His family told of a cooking enthusiast who loved meat but also prepared excellent vegan food for the vegan family members. His friends tell with deep longing about Yagave who was a quiet and modest person, interested in a very wide range of subjects: poetry, music, philosophy, politics and more. Self-taught who never stopped expanding knowledge and interest.  On the morning of October 7th, Yagav and Ramon were abducted from their home in the kibbutz, from the MMD, which on normal days was used as the workshop where her son Yagav repaired his guitars. Rimon was released after 53 days as part of the women and children deal. Yagav survived for over 3 months in the tunnels in Gaza and was murdered in captivity.  Today, we will stop for a moment and remember Yagave. A family man, a lover of all living beings who spread sounds in the world that brought light and love.
